title: Assess verification definitions without requiring execution
preconditions: Use the quality status fixture with accepted criteria, required kinds, proposed/active cases, stale mappings, an excluded criterion and no run dependency.

steps.action: Inspect the accepted criterion requiring positive, negative and edge definitions, with positive absent and negative/edge present.
steps.expected_result: Positive is missing while negative and edge are covered.

steps.action: Remove all run metadata from the status fixture; then set cases to proposed and inspect the case without evidence.
steps.expected_result: The proposed case without evidence covers verification intent; removing runs leaves assembled status unchanged.

expected_result: Assess verification definitions without requiring execution.
